paths.relativePathEncoding: Project-relative slash-separated JSON paths, resolved to Windows paths internally. Traversal, absolute paths, device names and reparse points are rejected.
paths.raw: raw/<page-number>.raw contains each exact GetRawText UTF-8 document followed by LF, including embedded JSON formatting. raw/<page-number>.receipt.json binds byte lengths, per-document hashes, full page hash, charge, pass and continuation.
paths.checkpoint: checkpoint.json is a signed-integrity envelope with top-level runId/inputHash/requests/elapsedMillis/inFlight and full state. UI must not offer restart when inFlight=true or checkpoint.json.pending exists.
paths.conversion: conversion-<unique>/index/<hash-prefix>/<identity-hash>.identity.json and .record.json; canonical.ndjson follows the selected inventory order.
paths.completion: complete.json binds canonical/raw hashes, inventory, counts, fidelity and ownership; its checksum is committed into checkpoint state.
paths.enumeration: Requested directory owns its checkpoint, raw evidence for two passes, inventory-<unique>/ index and byte/count-bounded multi-stage sort files, identities.ndjson and manifest.json.
paths.extract: Requested new output plus <output>.manifest.json. Existing or incomplete outputs are preserved, never overwritten.

check.prerequisites: Explicit cosmos-documents mode, account-root endpoint, profile, environment credential reference, positive reviewed ruBudget and ruPerSecond. No identity inventory or fidelity approval required.
check.coverage: One actual all-container read-feed SDK page, at most 16 reserved attempts including metadata and internal HTTP attempts. It establishes read access only, not semantic fidelity.

enumeration.partitions: An empty array is supported. Candidates never restrict the all-partitions scan.
enumeration.maximumRequests: 1..10000000, including every reserved SDK HTTP attempt, metadata and retries, across both feeds.
enumeration.maximumDurationMillis: 1000..86400000, also bounded by project maximumOperationMillis; cumulative across restart.
enumeration.planHash: SHA256 of recursively property-sorted JSON, matching the existing Java plan hash for validated canonical JSON.
enumeration.coverage: Two complete feeds reconciled by exact partition/owner-qualified identity and per-document raw SHA256, independent of page order. No scalar-count SQL or Gremlin requests.
enumeration.sorting: Chunks bounded by batchRecords, 512 entries and batchBytes; multi-stage merge opens at most 16 input files.
enumeration.identityTypes: string-only refers to physical vertex/edge IDs and edge owner IDs; partitions remain typed.
enumeration.consistency: Requires immutable or quiesced. Identity-only enumeration does not require reduced-fidelity approval or metadata completeness.

probe.prerequisites: Selected manifest actual bytes SHA256, positive RU budget, matching run/input/source configuration and existing signed reduced-fidelity/best-effort approvals when applicable.
probe.reconciliation: Every manifest identity is indexed on disk. Missing, extra and duplicate physical documents or identities fail closed. Every edge source/destination must resolve to a partition-qualified manifest vertex.
probe.report: New owned schemaVersion=1 source-compatibility envelope, sensitiveArtifact=true. Success includes adapter/sdk/profile, sourceManifestHash, documentFidelity, gremlinSemanticCompatibility=not-established, sourceCountsReconciled, observedVertices/Edges, edgeScopes, rawSnapshotHash, canonicalPath/Sha256, consistency, requestCharge and fixed unobservable labels.
probe.blockedReport: Includes safe code/stage, partialRawSnapshot, sourceCountsReconciled=false and spendUnknown. The error acknowledgement includes artifactSha256 whenever a new report could be written.
probe.cacheReuse: Only fully verified same-run/input/config/inventory completion. Project phase/evidence/artifact changes do not invalidate its identity; source compatibilityEvidence alone is excluded from source binding.

extract.requests: Zero source requests. Current approvals, owned completion, raw/canonical hashes and exact current inventory are reverified.

profiles.property-bags-v1: String physical id and label; one flat typed partition key that does not collide with id/label/system/edge storage fields; vertex occurrence arrays with exact id/_value/optional _meta fields; flat scalar edge properties. Distinct IDs preserve repeated values; duplicate occurrence IDs are rejected across the vertex.
profiles.flat-v1: Flat scalar vertex properties have null occurrence IDs and reduced fidelity; no IDs are invented.
profiles.edge: _isEdge must be true when present. Source _vertexId and target _sink/_sinkPartition are required; own partition is the source partition. _vertexLabel/_sinkLabel become sourceLabel/destinationLabel metadata. Canonical edgeScope is sourceVertex, with inVPartition/outVPartition metadata.
profiles.scalars: Strings, booleans, arbitrary-precision canonical integers and finite JSON decimal/exponent lexicals, including partition values. Noninteger lexical text is preserved exactly as doubleValue but runtime float32/float64 identity is explicitly unobservable. A manifest requiring floatValue rather than the observed JSON doubleValue cannot be proven and does not match. Negative zero integer normalization is marked reduced.
profiles.metadata: All observed _rid/_self/_etag/_attachments/_ts are retained with types. Missing or wrong-shaped required metadata marks the record reduced. Missing _meta uses an empty storage-convention map but is not runtime Gremlin proof.
profiles.strict: Blocks any reduced conversion. A vertex's flat partition property has no observed occurrence ID, so these profiles necessarily reduce that property and typical vertex corpora cannot pass strict fidelity.
profiles.unsupported: Nulls, complex scalar values, unknown storage or occurrence fields, ambiguous flags, unsupported identities, missing endpoints, empty property bags and record/depth bound violations fail closed with raw evidence preserved.

transport.sdkApi: CosmosClient.GetContainer(...).GetItemQueryStreamIterator(queryDefinition:null, continuationToken:..., QueryRequestOptions) in Gateway mode. Actual SDK fixtures verify two physical partition-key ranges.
transport.scope: GET only, explicit endpoint origin, account root and selected collection/routing/docs paths only, including its verified RID paths. No writes, provisioning, SQL queries, other containers or Gremlin fallback.
transport.tls: System validation by default. Custom CA verifies hostname and a custom-root chain with server-auth EKU, intermediate certificates and no certificate downloads. No certificate-error bypass.
transport.accounting: Lazy SDK initialization follows durable inFlight intent. Every actual HTTP attempt is reserved; known account/collection/routing metadata may omit charge. Data responses must have charge. Observed transport charges are accumulated, rate-paced and checked against total budget. Unknown charge, lost response or interrupted in-flight work blocks restart.
transport.retries: SDK 429 retries are disabled. Bounded known retry-after is honored by the worker; request/time budgets also guard hidden SDK routing/metadata attempts. Unknown transport failures poison the pipeline.
transport.parent: --parent-owned monitors stdin EOF and exits immediately to prevent an orphan after host shutdown.

protocol.stdout: Exactly one terminal JSON acknowledgement line; preceding activity frames contain no raw documents, provider errors, resource values, secrets or tokens. Exit 0 succeeds; exit 2 blocks.
protocol.remediation: Preserve local evidence; verify source configuration, scoped approval and budgets before retrying.

validation.remainingProof: Real account access/storage-profile confirmation, installed VSIX handshake, custom-CA integration and Windows self-contained publish are coordinator validation. No live freshness or runtime Gremlin equivalence is established.

packaging.files: Every published leaf filename mapped to its SHA256. Self-contained publish with RestoreLockedMode=true. Script provided but not run during this bounded task.
